digo: Mnyumbu; Mchumbu (var. Mnyumbu madzi / Mchumbu madzi)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005

teaser.en: Its inner bark becomes string and baskets, its fruit is a snack, and its trunk becomes mortars and beehives.
teaser.sw: Gome lake la ndani hugeuka kamba na vikapu, tunda lake ni kitafunio, na shina lake hugeuka vinu na mizinga ya nyuki.

summary.en: *Mnyumbu*, the false marula, is a deciduous tree of wooded grassland and river valleys with flaking bark and small red-purple fruits. Almost every part is put to use, from string and dye to mortars, stools and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mnyumbu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wa nyika zenye miti na mabonde ya mito, wenye gome linalobambuka na matunda madogo mekundu-zambarau. Karibu kila sehemu yake hutumika, kuanzia kamba na rangi hadi vinu, vigoda na dawa.

about.en:
*Mnyumbu* is a deciduous tree up to 20 metres tall with grey-brown bark that flakes off. The leaves are made of a few shiny leaflets, crowded at the ends of the branches. The fruits are small and red-purple.

It looks something like its cousin the marula, *mng'ongo*, which is why it is called the false marula.
about.sw:
*Mnyumbu* ni mti unaopukutisha majani wenye urefu wa hadi mita 20 na gome la rangi ya kijivu-kahawia linalobambuka. Majani yake yana vijani vichache vinavyong'aa, vilivyosongamana kwenye ncha za matawi. Matunda yake ni madogo na mekundu-zambarau.

Unafanana kwa kiasi fulani na binamu yake marula, *mng'ongo*, ndiyo sababu kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *false marula*, yaani 'marula bandia'.

where.en: It grows in wooded grassland, dry forest and river valleys.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika zenye miti, misitu mikavu na mabonde ya mito.

uses.en:
The inner bark is stripped for string and woven into baskets, and the bark also gives a brown dye. The fruit is edible.

The wood is carved into mortars, stools and beehives. The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Gome la ndani huchunwa ili kutengeneza kamba na kusukwa vikapu, na gome pia hutoa rangi ya kahawia. Tunda lake huliwa.

Mbao huchongwa kuwa vinu, vigoda na mizinga ya nyuki. Gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mnyumbu* and *mchumbu*, and notes that they are interchangeable. Each has a variety with *madzi*, 'water', added: *mnyumbu madzi* and *mchumbu madzi*. The Giriama name is *mjumbu maji*. In Swahili it is *mnyumbu* or *mongo*; *mongo* is also used for the true marula.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mnyumbu* na *mchumbu*, na inaeleza kuwa yanatumika kwa kubadilishana. Kila moja lina aina yenye neno *madzi*, 'maji', lililoongezwa: *mnyumbu madzi* na *mchumbu madzi*. Jina la Kigiriama ni *mjumbu maji*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mnyumbu* au *mongo*; *mongo* pia hutumika kwa marula halisi.

reason.en: The true marula, a close relative
reason.sw: Marula halisi, jamaa yake wa karibu

reason.en: Wild fruit tree of the same family
reason.sw: Mti wa matunda ya porini wa familia moja

reason.en: Another member of the cashew family
reason.sw: Mwanafamilia mwingine wa familia ya mkorosho

reason.en: Also used for bark string and mats
reason.sw: Pia hutumika kwa kamba za gome na mikeka
